question: Was Jehu the son or grandson of Nimshi?
summary: 1 Kings 19:16 calls Jehu the son of Nimshi. 2 Kings 9:2 (and 9:14) calls him the son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi, making him Nimshi's grandson. The same person is given two different relationships to the same ancestor within the same narrative complex.

reconcile.connective: Defenders note that Hebrew "son" routinely means descendant, so calling Jehu "son of Nimshi" simply names his grandfather as ancestor.

discrepancy.connective: Steve Wells of the Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the plain wording: one verse makes Jehu Nimshi's son, the other his grandson, of the same man in the same story.
